answer: Make rewards conserve a buyer-funded task budget: a voyage planner buying grove surveys can spend 100 credits, whether one seller or a thousand aliases answer. Each signed receipt consumes a unique slice of that escrow; the ledger rejects reused receipts and pays no per-account signup bonus. Splitting a seller cannot enlarge the pot, and inventing buyers requires funding their purchases. This avoids the fable that more accounts imply more work. It removes the payout gain from sybils, not their ability to flood search results.
